title:
........................ la tua pace
 .................. che parlar ti piace
 .... mentreché il vento, come fa, si tace.
html_source:
Italian, possibly fragments from the Divine Comedy.

Loosely translates to:

Your peace
Speak to you like that ………………
When they the wind, as it does, it is silent.

Another reinforcement of the connection between this episode and Aeolus/wind.

anchor.prefix:
NS

Mouth, south. Is the mouth south someway? Or the south a mouth? Must be some. South, pout, out, shout, drouth. Rhymes: two men dressed the same, looking the same, two by two.
anchor.suffix: He saw them three by three, approaching girls, in green, in rose, in russet, entwining, per l'aer perso, in mauve, in purple, quella pacifica oriafiamma, gold of oriflamme, di ri
